## Design

### 2026-10-12 – I initially just wanted to do a mount for the laptop for dissipating heat, but realized that, 1. an angle is bad ergonomically, and 2. why not make it a case? since I can't find good cases for my lapt

**2.7h**

I initially just wanted to do a mount for the laptop for dissipating heat, but realized that, 1. an angle is bad ergonomically, and 2. why not make it a case? since I can't find good cases for my laptop.

so, here's the design:
we have a fitted bottom case, minus the hinge part of the laptop. extended out of the back (so when open the laptop doesn't hit the case hinge), there's a case hinge that can move 360 degrees. When up, there will be an upper case for the laptop. When under the bottom case, due to the extra hinge at the edge of the laptop (a lil hard to explain with words), it'll be able to make a flat mount with the last hinge near the lip of the case. The lip of the case will also include an L shape lock mech of sorts facing "out" that will correspond to one on the bottom of the case and one on the top of the case (when making sure the mount is secure vs closing the case). Looking at home much time it took for me to just get here, I have no idea if I can make the other things that I wanted to (the other ones are definitely less complicated, without hinges, etc. maybe the shapes and curves might be more difficult though). I do really want to make a "charm" that comes with the case though.

tldr: finished bottom side of case, ready for hinge, confirmed concepts and made sure they work in theory
